extracted.intended_audience: USPTO patent examiners, patent prosecutors, patent practitioners, and applicants
extracted.subtask_description: Table of contents for the Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP), Eighth Edition, Revision 6 (September 2007). Lists chapters and appendices that define topics, procedures, and standards used in U.S. patent examination and practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consolidated Laws
rubrics_metrics.description: the latest published version of the patent laws (Appendix L of the MPEP or Consolidated Patent Laws, whichever is more current).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates which statutory consolidation is current for use with the MPEP; see Appendix L for text. E8r6 notes which consolidated laws are current as of the revision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consolidated Rules
rubrics_metrics.description: the latest published version of the patent rules (Appendix R of the MPEP or Consolidated Patent Rules, whichever is more current).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates which rules consolidation is current; see Appendix R for regulatory text referenced throughout the MPEP.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to obtain a copy of the MPEP
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on how to obtain copies of the MPEP (PDF, HTML, zipped files, DVD-ROM, paper).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides ordering/contact information for PDF, HTML, DVD-ROM, and paper copies and notes availability of zipped chapter files for download.

rubrics_metrics.name: MPEP Archives / Current MPEP (E8r6)
rubrics_metrics.description: The 'E8r6' column includes the PDF documents updated in Revision 6 of the Eighth Edition of the MPEP, dated September 2007.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies which documents were updated in Revision 6 (Blue Pages; Title Page; Chapters 700, 1800, 2100; Appendices II, L, R, T, AI; Index) and that HTML files will be replaced shortly with E8r6 html files.

rubrics_metrics.name: Blue Pages
rubrics_metrics.description: Blue Pages (Blue) — Blue Pages section of the MPEP as indicated in TOC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Blue Pages are organizational/front-matter material in the MPEP; updated files available in E8r6 PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title Page
rubrics_metrics.description: Title (Title) — Title Page entry in the MPEP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Front matter; E8r6 includes updated Title Page PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foreword
rubrics_metrics.description: FWD — Foreword entry in the MPEP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Introductory material for the MPEP; available in the E8r6 PDF package.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table of Contents
rubrics_metrics.description: TOC — Table of Contents for the MPEP (this page).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists all chapters, appendices, and indexes; serves as the locator for detailed procedure and guidance throughout the manual.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction
rubrics_metrics.description: Intro — Introduction to the Manual of Patent Examining Procedure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Overview of MPEP purpose, organization, and use; see full Introduction chapter in MPEP E8r6 for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0100 — Secrecy, Access, National Security, and Foreign Filing
rubrics_metrics.description: 100 Secrecy, Access, National Security, and Foreign Filing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treats secrecy orders, national security considerations, foreign filing licenses, and related procedures; consult chapter 0100 for procedures and rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0200 — Types, Cross-Noting, and Status of Application
rubrics_metrics.description: 200 Types, Cross-Noting, and Status of Application
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers application types (provisional, nonprovisional), cross-noting, and application status issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0300 — Ownership and Assignment
rubrics_metrics.description: 300 Ownership and Assignment
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discusses rules and procedures regarding ownership, transfer, and assignment of patent rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0400 — Representative of Inventor or Owner
rubrics_metrics.description: 400 Representative of Inventor or Owner
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses who may represent applicants before the USPTO and related practitioner rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0500 — Receipt and Handling of Mail and Papers
rubrics_metrics.description: 500 Receipt and Handling of Mail and Papers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures for receipt, date-stamping, and handling of correspondence and documents filed with the Office.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0600 — Parts, Form, and Content of Application
rubrics_metrics.description: 600 Parts, Form, and Content of Application
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards for required parts of an application, form and content requirements (specification, claims, drawings, oath/declaration).

rubrics_metrics.name: 0700 — Examination of Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: 700 Examination of Applications
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance and procedures on substantive examination of patent applications, including searching and applying statutes and rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0800 — Restriction in Applications Filed Under 35 U.S.C. 111; Double Patenting
rubrics_metrics.description: 800 Restriction in Applications Filed Under 35 U.S.C. 111; Double Patenting
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers restriction practice, election of species, and double patenting issues under 35 U.S.C. 111.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0900 — Prior Art, Classification, and Search
rubrics_metrics.description: 900 Prior Art, Classification, and Search
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures for prior art searching, classification of applications, and related examiner practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1000 — Matters Decided by Various U.S. Patent and Trademark Office Officials
rubrics_metrics.description: 1000 Matters Decided by Various U.S. Patent and Trademark Office Officials
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes decision-making responsibilities and appeal/decision processes within the USPTO.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1100 — Statutory Invention Registration (SIR) and Pre-Grant Publication (PG Pub)
rubrics_metrics.description: 1100 Statutory Invention Registration (SIR) and Pre-Grant Publication (PG Pub)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains SIR and pre-grant publication procedures and requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1200 — Appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: 1200 Appeal
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures for appeal from examiner decisions to the Patent Trial and Appeal Board and related filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1300 — Allowance and Issue
rubrics_metrics.description: 1300 Allowance and Issue
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on requirements and procedures for allowance of claims and issuance of patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1400 — Correction of Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: 1400 Correction of Patents
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules and procedures for correcting errors in issued patents (reissue, certificate of correction, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: 1500 — Design Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: 1500 Design Patents
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practice and requirements specific to design patent applications and examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1600 — Plant Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: 1600 Plant Patents
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practice and requirements specific to plant patent applications and examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1700 — Miscellaneous
rubrics_metrics.description: 1700 Miscellaneous
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers various topics not assigned to other chapters; see chapter for specific items.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1800 — Patent Cooperation Treaty
rubrics_metrics.description: 1800 Patent Cooperation Treaty
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on PCT procedures as they relate to U.S. national phase entry and related matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1900 — Protest
rubrics_metrics.description: 1900 Protest
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures for filing and adjudicating protests against pending patent applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2000 — Duty of Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: 2000 Duty of Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards and obligations under the duty of disclosure (duty to disclose material information, information disclosure statements).

rubrics_metrics.name: 2100 — Patentability
rubrics_metrics.description: 2100 Patentability
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Core substantive patentability guidance (novelty, nonobviousness, statutory subject matter, enablement, written description) — see Chapter 2100 for detailed treatment.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2200 — Citation of Prior Art and Ex Parte Reexamination of Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: 2200 Citation of Prior Art and Ex Parte Reexamination of Patents
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures for citation of prior art and ex parte reexamination proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2300 — Interference Proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: 2300 Interference Proceedings
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures for interference (priority) proceedings as applicable under the law in effect at the time.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2400 — Biotechnology
rubrics_metrics.description: 2400 Biotechnology
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Special considerations and guidance for biotechnology-related applications (e.g., deposit requirements, sequence listings).

rubrics_metrics.name: 2500 — Maintenance Fees
rubrics_metrics.description: 2500 Maintenance Fees
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules and procedures for payment and collection of maintenance fees for granted patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2600 — Optional Inter Partes Reexamination
rubrics_metrics.description: 2600 Optional Inter Partes Reexamination
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on optional inter partes reexamination procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2700 — Patent Terms and Extensions
rubrics_metrics.description: 2700 Patent Terms and Extensions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules and calculations for patent term adjustments and extensions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix I - Partial List of Trademarks
rubrics_metrics.description: Ap I — Appendix I - Partial List of Trademarks
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appendix listing trademarks referenced in the manual.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix II - List of Decisions Cited
rubrics_metrics.description: Ap II — Appendix II - List of Decisions Cited
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Index of judicial and Board decisions cited in the MPEP chapters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix L - Patent Laws
rubrics_metrics.description: Ap L — Appendix L - Patent Laws
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Text of applicable patent statutes or consolidated patent laws for reference; identifies which laws are current as of the revision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix R - Patent Rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Ap R — Appendix R - Patent Rules
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Text of the Patent Rules (CFR) or consolidated rules for reference; used throughout the MPEP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix T - Patent Cooperation Treaty
rubrics_metrics.description: Ap T — Appendix T - Patent Cooperation Treaty
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Text and relevant administrative instructions under the PCT applicable to national phase practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix AI - Administrative Instructions Under The PCT
rubrics_metrics.description: Ap AI — Appendix AI - Administrative Instructions Under The PCT
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Administrative instructions relevant to PCT practice and national phase entry; see appendix for specifics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix P - Paris Convention
rubrics_metrics.description: Ap P — Appendix P - Paris Convention
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Text of the Paris Convention provisions as relevant to patent priority and related matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Index - Subject Matter Index
rubrics_metrics.description: Index — Index - Subject Matter Index
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subject-matter index to locate topics across the MPEP chapters; updated in E8r6 where noted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Zipped and PDF packaged versions of the MPEP
rubrics_metrics.description: Zipped version of the MPEP E8r6 in the PDF format and zipped E8r5 HTML files (chapters grouped into download packages).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Downloadable packaged files available for Chapters 100-1000, 1100-2700, appendices, and PDF index files; useful for bulk access to the manual.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability on DVD-ROM and Paper (ordering information)
rubrics_metrics.description: Availability of MPEP on Paper and in Other Formats (DVD-ROM, paper) with ordering and contact information for Office of Electronic Information Products and Superintendent of Documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides contact details, telephone numbers, and mailing addresses for ordering physical or DVD-ROM copies and for subscription inquiries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Web Page Revision History
rubrics_metrics.description: Web Page Revision History listing dates when various E8 revisions and files were added (e.g., Oct 2007 — Added MPEP E8 Rev. 6 PDF Files, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Documents when online materials were updated and which revision files became available; helps users determine currency of guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Key / Legend for links and resources
rubrics_metrics.description: KEY indicating link icons for online business system, fees, forms, help, laws/regulations, definition (glossary).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains icons used on the web page to navigate to related resources (forms, laws, help pages).

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventors Assistance Center and USPTO Contact
rubrics_metrics.description: The Inventors Assistance Center is available to help on patent matters; directs questions to the USPTO Contact Center (UCC) and provides webmaster contact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on where to send inquiries and suggestions about USPTO webpages and services; administrative contact information.
